reply.text:
I'm not going to build a plan around getting skinny fast while you stay hungry. That's not a place I'll coach from, and a thigh gap mostly comes down to bone structure, so no amount of dieting guarantees it. Wanting to eat very little is something to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian first.

Once you've done that, I'm glad to help with the training side: getting stronger, building energy and fitness, and making your week feel good. Come back to me when you're ready.
